summary: This directory serves as the dedicated testing suite for verifying the configuration resolution logic. It contains integration and unit tests that ensure the system correctly processes, resolves, and validates application settings under various conditions.
responsibilities: Ensuring accurate handling of configuration settings
relationships: Integration tests verify that the configuration resolution process functions correctly within the broader system context.
Unit tests validate individual components of the configuration resolver to ensure isolated logical correctness.
designDecisions: Separation of unit and integration testing concerns
Focus on verifying resolution outcomes against expected configuration states
